pictures.author: H Raghibi
pictures.observations: Close brick body/cone view: deep sharp vertical flutes, upper pointed corbel cells and surviving blue/turquoise decorative fragments; a small closed pointed repair panel between ribs. Trees obscure parts of the exterior.

pictures.author: H Raghibi
pictures.observations: Entrance close-up: projecting pale pointed porch, stacked blind pointed recesses, low grilled doorway and long brick ribs. Do not copy signs, cables or inscription forms.

pictures.author: Pouyakhani
pictures.observations: Whole-tower view resolves the squat conical cap versus tall ribbed body, upper hood rhythm/blue fragments and projecting entrance porch. The lower image is cropped/masked; foundation engineering remains a visualization estimate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Aladdin mausoleum tower in Varamin: thirty-two sharp brick flutes, low conical brick cap, upper pointed corbel/blind-cell rhythm with sparse original geometric turquoise fragments, one small blind repair niche, projecting pale pointed entrance porch/stacked recesses/closed grilled doorway, and bounded buried footing. Four existing shared brick/stucco/tile/paint graphs; no copied calligraphy, photograph atlas, furnished tomb, assumed pristine full tile restoration, whole square or broad precinct slab.
